title: Mobile-First Cyberpunk Dashboard UI
description: Develop a zero-CDN, offline-resilient mobile-first dashboard featuring cyberpunk/fintech dark-mode aesthetics, responsive layout, ticker banner, active trade card, forecast grid, orderbook wall visualizer, and MEV radar.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML/CSS/JS assets load entirely self-hosted with zero external CDN dependencies
Dashboard renders ticker, trade setup, timeframe forecast, orderbook walls, and MEV radar
Python unit tests verify HTML structure, element IDs, and asset bundling integrity
